Infinity Rising x Anvil Partnership Announcement
,
Today we are officially announcing a strategic partnership between Infinity Rising and Anvil.

This collaboration has one clear goal. Build player first Web3 infrastructure that stays out of the way of gameplay.

Both teams share the same belief. If players have to think about the blockchain, we have already failed.

Together, Infinity Rising and Anvil will be working on long term infrastructure focused on
• Seamless onboarding for mainstream players
• Intuitive in game transactions and signing
• True asset ownership that feels native to gameplay
• Scalable systems built for real games, not experiments
Infinity Rising will act as an early launch partner and design collaborator, ensuring everything built is grounded in real gameplay needs rather than theory.
This is a long term, product driven partnership. The focus is not on hype, but on building the right foundations the right way with player experience leading every decision.

You can read the full press release here
https://infinityrising.com/blog/infinity-anvil-partnership

Liquidity & Rewards Update

We’re making a few strategic updates to our liquidity structure and staking rewards to improve token accessibility and optimize capital deployment.

Total emissions are being reduced slightly now that the 90-day post-migration incentive period has ended. These changes are targeted to be fully live by early next week, with a follow-up announcement once everything is active.

 Liquidity Changes

• We’re launching a new RISE pool on Uniswap V2 (Base)
• Liquidity will be rebalanced from Aerodrome and a small portion from Cardano Minswap
• Aerodrome V2 remains our deepest Base pool — this is an additional venue, not a replacement
• Minswap retains the vast majority of its liquidity and remains fully operational

Why Uniswap?
Coinbase’s DEX swap feature routes through aggregators (0x + 1inch) that pull from both Uniswap and Aerodrome. Adding Uniswap provides a second routing path into Coinbase and broader aggregator coverage — without the token-import friction that currently exists on Aerodrome.

Result: easier discovery and fewer steps to trade RISE.

Aerodrome Slipstream is being retired for now as its rewards program has ended. At current volumes, full-range V2 liquidity across more accessible venues is a better use of capital. We’ll revisit Slipstream as volume grows.

 Updated RISE Rewards (Daily)

• VyFi Staking: 6% APR (unchanged)
• Base Staking: 27,000 → 23,000
• Minswap LP: 38,250 (unchanged)
• Base Aerodrome V2: 22,950 → 20,000 / day
• Base Aerodrome Slipstream: 15,300 → retired
• Base Uniswap V2 (evm-staking): 13,250 (new)
• Base Uniswap V2 – Merkl: 5,000 (new)

 Why Merkl?

We’re allocating a portion of RISE rewards via Merkl for the Uniswap V2 pool.

Merkl is widely used by LPs, with 10,000+ daily active yield farmers browsing opportunities — giving RISE exposure beyond our existing community.

 Important (Please Read)

If you are a Uniswap LP and stake your LP tokens on
evm-staking.infinityrising.com, you will also earn Merkl rewards.

• Merkl tracks LP ownership directly on-chain, regardless of where LP tokens are held
• Merkl rewards accrue to the evm-staking contract
• At the end of the 3-month Merkl campaign, rewards are distributed to stakers based on their proportional share
• Staking multipliers apply only to LPs staked through our evm-staking platform

More updates soon once everything is live.
